moments.title: Premier League Transfer Deadline Day
moments.blurb: The summer transfer window for the Premier League closes today, September 1st, at 11 PM BST, with clubs scrambling to finalize last-minute deals.

angles.name: Last-minute deals
angles.copy: Clocks ticking! It's Premier League Transfer Deadline Day and teams have until 11 PM to get those last-minute deals over the line. Who are you hoping your club signs?

angles.name: Biggest spenders
angles.copy: Who's been the biggest spender this summer, and who's got the best value? All eyes on the transfer window closing tonight!

moments.title: Great British Bake Off Returns
moments.blurb: Season 16 of The Great British Bake Off kicks off tomorrow, September 2nd, on Channel 4, with a fresh batch of bakers and new judge Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood.

angles.name: Bake Off is back!
angles.copy: Ready, set, BAKE! The Great British Bake Off returns tomorrow with a new judge in the tent. Who's excited for soggy bottoms and showstoppers?

angles.name: New judge Nigella
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson is joining the Bake Off tent! We can't wait to see her take on the judging alongside Paul Hollywood. Tune in tomorrow on Channel 4!

moments.title: Happy 30th Birthday Zendaya
moments.blurb: American actress and singer Zendaya, known for 'Euphoria' and 'Spider-Man', celebrates her 30th birthday today, September 1st.

angles.name: Zendaya turns 30!
angles.copy: Happy 30th Birthday to the incredible Zendaya! From Disney star to Hollywood icon, what's your favourite Zendaya moment or song?

angles.name: Celebrating Zendaya
angles.copy: She's 30 today! Sending big birthday wishes to Zendaya, a true talent across music and screen. Play her biggest hits with us now!

moments.title: Happy 69th Birthday Gloria Estefan
moments.blurb: Cuban-American singer-songwriter and businesswoman Gloria Estefan, a global icon known for fusing Latin rhythms with pop, turns 69 today, September 1st.

angles.name: Gloria Estefan's 69th
angles.copy: Get On Your Feet! It's Gloria Estefan's 69th birthday today! We're celebrating the Queen of Latin Pop with her timeless hits. What's your favourite?

angles.name: Conga!
angles.copy: Happy Birthday to the legendary Gloria Estefan! Her music still gets us dancing. Join us in celebrating her 69th today!

moments.title: Happy 42nd Birthday Joe Trohman (Fall Out Boy)
moments.blurb: Joe Trohman, lead guitarist and co-founder of the influential rock band Fall Out Boy, celebrates his 42nd birthday today, September 1st.

angles.name: Fall Out Boy's Joe Trohman turns 42
angles.copy: Happy 42nd Birthday to Fall Out Boy's very own Joe Trohman! We're cranking up the FOB hits to celebrate his big day. What's your favourite track?

angles.name: Celebrating Joe Trohman
angles.copy: From 'Sugar, We're Goin Down' to now, Joe Trohman has been a rock icon. Wishing the Fall Out Boy guitarist a very Happy Birthday!

moments.title: EFL Matches Live Tonight
moments.blurb: Tonight, September 1st, sees a full schedule of EFL League One, League Two, and Championship matches across the UK.

angles.name: Live EFL action
angles.copy: Football fix tonight? The EFL is in full swing with a packed schedule across League One, League Two, and the Championship! Get your scores and updates here.

angles.name: Swansea City in action
angles.copy: It's a big night for Welsh football fans as Swansea City take on Watford in the Championship tonight! Score predictions?

moments.title: Back to School Week
moments.blurb: Most schools across England and Wales are returning for the new academic year this week, with many pupils starting back today or over the next couple of days.

angles.name: Schools are back!
angles.copy: The summer holidays are officially over for many! Good luck to all the kids, teachers, and parents heading back to school this week!

angles.name: First day nerves (or relief?)
angles.copy: Whether it's the first day of reception or the final year of sixth form, it's back to school for thousands across the UK. How are you feeling about it?

moments.title: Moseley Folk & Arts Festival
moments.blurb: The Moseley Folk & Arts Festival kicks off tomorrow, September 2nd, running until September 4th, bringing a diverse line-up of music and arts to Moseley Park, Birmingham.

angles.name: Folk & Arts in Moseley
angles.copy: Moseley Folk & Arts Festival begins tomorrow! Get ready for three days of incredible music and culture in the heart of Birmingham.

angles.name: Birmingham's festival
angles.copy: Who's heading to Moseley Park this week for the Folk & Arts Festival? The countdown is on for a fantastic few days!

moments.title: Lindisfarne Festival Starts Thursday
moments.blurb: Lindisfarne Festival returns this Thursday, September 3rd, until September 6th, offering music and arts at Beal Farm, Northumberland.

angles.name: Northumberland calling!
angles.copy: Lindisfarne Festival kicks off this Thursday! Four days of epic music and good vibes await on the Northumberland coast.

angles.name: Festival week is here
angles.copy: Who's packed their wellies and is ready for Lindisfarne Festival? It's almost time for the North East's biggest party!

moments.title: Taskmaster Series 22 Begins
moments.blurb: The hilariously silly competition 'Taskmaster' returns for its 22nd series this Thursday, September 3rd, at 9 PM on Channel 4.

angles.name: Your new Taskmaster obsession
angles.copy: Your favourite absurd comedy is back! Taskmaster Series 22 starts this Thursday on Channel 4. What's the strangest task you'd set?

angles.name: Who will win Taskmaster?
angles.copy: New contestants, new challenges, same brilliant chaos. Taskmaster returns Thursday at 9 PM! Get ready to laugh.

moments.title: Happy 45th Birthday Beyoncé
moments.blurb: Global superstar Beyoncé, the iconic singer-songwriter and actress, will celebrate her 45th birthday on September 4th.

angles.name: Queen Bey turns 45!
angles.copy: All hail Queen Bey! Beyoncé celebrates her 45th birthday this Friday. What's your ultimate Beyoncé power anthem?

angles.name: Celebrating Beyoncé
angles.copy: From Destiny's Child to solo superstardom, Beyoncé has redefined music. Wishing a fabulous 45th to the one and only this Friday!

moments.title: The British Country Music Festival
moments.blurb: The British Country Music Festival takes place from September 4th to 6th in Blackpool, showcasing world-class international and UK country and Americana artists.

angles.name: Country comes to Blackpool
angles.copy: Yee-haw! The British Country Music Festival kicks off this Friday in Blackpool. Get ready for a weekend of brilliant country and Americana!

angles.name: Festival vibes
angles.copy: Heading to Blackpool for The British Country Music Festival? Who are you most excited to see performing?

moments.title: Allday Indie Festival Cardiff
moments.blurb: The Allday Indie - Open Air Outdoor Indie Festival takes place in Cardiff this Saturday, September 5th, at Tiger Yard.

angles.name: Indie takeover in Cardiff
angles.copy: Cardiff! Get ready for the Allday Indie Festival this Saturday at Tiger Yard. Who's excited for a day of open-air indie anthems?

angles.name: Welsh indie weekend
angles.copy: This Saturday, Cardiff's Tiger Yard hosts the Allday Indie Festival. If you're heading down, let us know your favourite indie bangers!

moments.title: Premier League Matchweek 4
moments.blurb: The Premier League continues this weekend with Matchweek 4, featuring a full slate of fixtures on Saturday, September 5th, and Sunday, September 6th.

angles.name: Weekend football is here!
angles.copy: Premier League action returns this weekend! Which fixture are you most looking forward to on Saturday and Sunday?

angles.name: Big games this weekend
angles.copy: Arsenal vs Chelsea and Everton vs Man Utd headline Sunday's Premier League fixtures. Who are you backing to win?

moments.title: Peter Kay Live in Cardiff
moments.blurb: Comedian Peter Kay brings his highly anticipated live show to Utilita Arena Cardiff for both a matinee and evening performance this Sunday, September 6th.

angles.name: Peter Kay in Wales!
angles.copy: He's back! Peter Kay takes over Utilita Arena Cardiff this Sunday for two shows. Who's managed to get tickets for the comedy legend?

angles.name: Comedy gold in Cardiff
angles.copy: This Sunday, Cardiff is set for laughs as Peter Kay performs live. If you're going, what's your favourite Peter Kay joke?
